businesses.business: fiber network provider and communications infrastructure

offering_description.value: Owns and operates fiber networks and communications infrastructure in the US. Sells fiber-based broadband to consumers and businesses, plus wholesale fiber transport, dark fiber and small cell connectivity to carriers, enterprises and governments.

primary_products.value: fiber broadband internet; dark fiber; wholesale fiber transport; small cell connectivity

primary_services.value: consumer and business broadband service; wholesale fiber leasing; managed network and voice services; fiber construction

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential broadband subscribers; B2B: wireless carriers, enterprises, other telecom carriers, hyperscalers; B2G: federal, state and local government agencies

end_markets.value: telecommunications; wireless carriers; residential broadband; enterprise networking; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly residential and business broadband and voice service; rental or leasing: long-term leases of dark fiber and wholesale capacity to carriers; service fees: managed network services and construction fees
revenue_model.category: subscription; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates fiber networks, conduit and last-mile infrastructure, serving carriers and consumers; service provider: retail broadband and enterprise connectivity to households and businesses

geography_served.value: US national: Fiber networks across about 18 US states, mainly Southeast, Midwest and Texas, plus wholesale nationwide

specialization.value: related lines: consumer fiber broadband, wholesale fiber leasing and enterprise connectivity on shared network assets

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise and wholesale sales teams selling to carriers and businesses; online: consumer broadband sign-up via website and call centers; other: door-to-door and retail agents for residential fiber

regulatory_exposure.value: high: telecommunications carrier licensing and FCC and state public utility commission rules, broadband subsidy programs

notes: Uniti merged with Windstream in 2025; consumer business details and state count are approximate.
